== Introduction ==

"The Dark Deck I Built For Clint"

Steven played this deck in Game 2 of the Final Confrontation against Gary Carman. The result was a win by 3 Force. The quality of play was excellent, with Steve battling it out until the end (though he needed a 23 Force victory to wrestle the title from Gary) and pulling some skillful moves right up until the end to bring down Gary's HBX deck.
